refusal.reason: No admission-ready evidence on either route for 'Env2.Decay' (capability_key=envelope2_field_decay). REFUSE.

reproduction.also_tried: Constructing ProducerBrain(epoch=EPOCH_2_0_23, binding_evidence_dir='serum2/qualification/binding_evidence') -- same refusal, because Gap B (below) means RouteSelector never sees the epoch-aware registry regardless.

root_causes.summary: Evidence-derived contracts register under atlas_id naming ('env2.decay'); SEMANTIC_TARGETS/TargetResolver require strict equality against the legacy capability_key naming ('envelope2_field_decay').
root_causes.evidence: Constructing ContractRegistry(epoch=EPOCH_2_0_23, binding_evidence_dir='serum2/qualification/binding_evidence') DOES produce a real CapabilityContract for env2.decay (status=STRUCTURAL_ONLY, execution_binding=SERUM_PRESET_STRUCTURAL -> Env1.plainParams.kParamDecay), confirmed by direct inspection: reg.contracts['env2.decay'] is populated, reg.binding_diagnostics['loaded'] includes 'env2.decay'. But targets.py's resolution (serum2/compiler/targets.py:417) does 'c.target == ref.capability_key', i.e. it looks for contracts['envelope2_field_decay'], which does not exist.
files: serum2/producer/concept_representation.py:111 (explicit design comment against fuzzy name/suffix matching)
root_causes.do_not_fix_with: Fuzzy/suffix-based contract lookup -- concept_representation.py:111 explicitly warns this would let env2.decay borrow env1's contract. Any fix must be an explicit, hand-reviewed capability_key<->atlas_id crosswalk, never a runtime string heuristic.

root_causes.summary: RouteSelector.__init__ (serum2/producer/route_selection.py:152) hardcodes `self._fresh_registry = ContractRegistry()` with no epoch/binding_evidence_dir, completely independent of the epoch-aware registry ProducerBrain builds for itself (self._registry). Even if Gap A is fixed, RouteSelector's own internal evidence-tier check never sees the promoted env2.decay contract, so it still reports UNQUALIFIED/REFUSE for both DAWDREAMER_SERUM and ABLETON_MCP routes.
root_causes.confirmed_by: This is the actual origin of the 'No admission-ready evidence on either route' message (serum2/producer/route_selection.py:234), which is the exact refusal text produced in the reproduction above.

proposed_fix_scope_minimal_env2_decay_on: 1. Add one explicit capability_key<->atlas_id crosswalk entry mapping 'envelope2_field_decay' <-> 'env2.decay' (reviewed by hand, not derived by string matching).

2. Change RouteSelector.__init__ to accept an optional injected ContractRegistry (default unchanged: ContractRegistry() for backward compatibility), and have ProducerBrain pass its own self._registry.
3. Preserve strict target-key equality everywhere else (do not relax targets.py:417's check).

4. Preserve the A2 admission gate exactly as-is; add regression tests covering: (a) env2.decay now resolves through RouteSelector when given the epoch-aware registry, (b) env1.decay / env2.decay remain distinguishable (no cross-contamination), (c) the default no-epoch legacy behavior (existing ~40 pickle-store contracts) is unchanged.

5. Rerun the canonical path: ProducerBrain(epoch=EPOCH_2_0_23, binding_evidence_dir=..., promoted_evidence_dir=...).execute(ProducerRequest(...)) end to end through finalize_serum_preset_execution(), and confirm proof_level reaches LIVE_UI_VERIFIED only when native evidence is fed back in.
